digest.component_or_area: rebar fsck/doctor wedge detection and repair
propositions: fsck must detect and classify the dirty-tracker wedge class: tracked deletions of store artifacts, untracked regenerable compaction leftovers, and orphaned .tmp-event-* files
doctor --repair must heal wedged stores using two non-overlapping write-lock windows: one for file mutations (restore/quarantine) and one for convergence (reconverge self-locks)
fsck --output json must report per-class counts and paths for each dirty-tracker finding kind via the _STRUCTURED_KINDS registry
doctor --repair must record a backup ref at HEAD before mutations, quarantine moved files (never delete), and leave .tmp-event-* files untouched
write_lock is non-reentrant and must not be held when reconverge is entered; file-mutating steps must acquire and release the lock before convergence begins
doctor --repair on a clean store must be idempotent: zero changes, zero backup ref, successful exit
